messages:
maria: Acme just pinged legal + procurement. they want SSO + tenant routing in MVP and say they'll sign dedicated capacity if we do Jan. can we triage?
kevin: what's the size of the work? is this mostly auth + infra?
sarah: breakdown: auth integration + cert handling (3 dev sprints), tenant routing config + tests (2 sprints), minimal UX (1 sprint). security review adds a mandatory week for cert approvals.
ethan: operationally tenant routing introduces routing tables + per-tenant config. we need rollout safety: feature flag and a small pilot. otherwise canary risk to latency.
camille: note: security review blackout 2024-02-06 -> 02-10. if we miss it, certs push out 3 weeks.
maria: putting three options on the table:
Option 1 - Status quo: Ship MVP as planned without SSO/tenant routing. Move Acme onboarding to v1. Timeline unchanged.
Option 2 - Full add to MVP: Accept SSO + tenant routing in MVP. Cut analytics dashboard and some admin conveniences. Canary shifts ~2 weeks. Revenue win but tight on security slot.
Option 3 - Feature-flagged pilot: Implement SSO + tenant routing behind a flag for 1-3 tenants (Acme). Keeps timeline mostly intact, higher ops overhead and manual enablement.
kevin: my vote: Option 3. less risky than full add, keeps the commercial upside.
sarah: Option 3 still needs a lightweight admin UI to toggle tenant routing per tenant (~3-4 dev days). we can scope the pilot to avoid broader admin features.
ethan: define canary SLOs if we go pilot: p95 < 120ms for auth path, error-rate < 0.3%. if violated, automated rollback: `deploy rollback acme-ssobeta`.
camille: ops-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall runbook review 2024-01-09 10:00 PST. ensure rollout playbook added.
maria: ok consensus for Option 3 for now. next steps: i'm going to prepare a micro-cutlist and the feature-flag rollout doc.
kevin: i'll update milestone tracker: add a 'pilot gating' row, link to security-window approval boolean. if meeting decides Option 2, shift canary by +2 weeks and mark cutlist entry.
sarah: i'll draft QA test plan focused on multi-tenant routing and cert edge cases. estimate 6 test cases + performance smoke.
ethan: ops: i'll build the alerting rule for auth p95 and error-rate, tie to oncall escalation.
maria: scheduling a decision sync tomorrow 2024-01-10 15:00 PST to lock the cutlist. invite sent. i'll post the final decision + short doc afterward. :memo:
